distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) reported Shaanxi with a locality transcribed as Jiaoping under the name Sphaerotrypes ulmi. The source's precise historical locality spelling and modern administrative identity have not been independently verified. Huang & Lu (2015) retained Shaanxi without more detailed locality information. These are published records; the occurrence assessment remains Candidate. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Sichuan, Shanxi as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.
